description: 2026 Qualified Business Income deduction (Section 199A, Form 8995 / 8995-A) for one trade or business: 20% of QBI at or below the $201,750 threshold ($403,500 mfj), the phase-in range up to $276,750 ($553,500 mfj) with the SSTB applicable percentage and the W-2 wage / UBIA limit, the SSTB phase-out, 20% of REIT/PTP income and the overall cap of 20% of taxable income minus net capital gain. Same math as the free web calculator. Planning estimate, not tax advice.

net_capital_gain.description: Net capital gain (including qualified dividends) for the overall cap

qbi.description: Qualified business income from the business (e.g. Schedule C profit minus the deductible half of SE tax, SE health insurance and retirement contributions), USD

reit_ptp_income.description: Qualified REIT dividends plus qualified PTP income

sstb.description: Specified service trade or business (health, law, accounting, consulting, financial services, performing arts, athletics, etc.). Default false

taxable_income.description: 2026 taxable income BEFORE the QBI deduction, USD

ubia.description: Unadjusted basis immediately after acquisition (UBIA) of qualified property

w2_wages.description: W-2 wages the business paid to employees

name: qbi_deduction
title: 2026 QBI deduction (Section 199A)
